subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: Should Feishu drive `info` add a folder-scoped lookup contract for pagination instead of attempting automatic root-wide draining?
rationale: Current main fixes manual folder list continuation, but `info` cannot safely paginate without deciding how callers supply the folder scope and how root/no-folder cases should behave for Feishu bot credentials.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
options.body: Expose or require a concrete folder scope for `info`, paginate within that folder, and prove later-page lookup through the real tool dispatch and SDK boundary.

options.title: Attempt automatic root draining
options.body: Keep `info` token-only and try to page from the root, accepting the known bot-credential root limitation and higher risk of false failures.

options.title: Leave token-only info unchanged
options.body: Document that `info` is first-page/root-limited and rely on callers to use paginated `list` for folder traversal.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
recommendation.body: Expose or require a concrete folder scope for `info`, paginate within that folder, and prove later-page lookup through the real tool dispatch and SDK boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main partial fix and left the latest scoping comment for the remaining `info` behavior.
